## Contributing [...] KIVI is a new plug-and-play 2bit KV cache quantization algorithm without any fine-tuning. This algorithm optimizes memory usage by quantizing the key cache per-channel and the value cache per-token to 2bit. KIVI's hardware-friendly design allows LLMs like Llama-2, Falcon, and Mistral to maintain comparable quality levels while reducing peak memory usage by 2.6 times. This enables up to 4 times larger batch sizes and significantly increases throughput by 2.35 to 3.47 times in real LLM inference [...] [2024.04.12]: We add support for the Mistral model family. The performance of LongChat-7b-v1.5-32K and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 on 15 tasks from LongBench can be found in long\_bench.md.
 [2024.04.05]: We release the code for reproducing our CoQA/TruthfulQA/GSM8K results using LM-Eval. Please check the README of branch lmeval.
 [2024.04.04]: 🔥🔥We add a new 5-digit passkey example with 12k context length to show the performance of 2bit KIVI under the long context senario.

results.title: KIVI: A Tuning-Free Asymmetric 2bit Quantization for KV Cache | alphaXiv
results.content: This paper is cited as a key related work that also tackles the KV cache bottleneck. KIVI's authors reference FlexGen's use of 4-bit group-wise quantization for both key and value caches, positioning their own asymmetric quantization strategy as a more nuanced and effective approach for lower bit-rates. [...] This paper's findings are fundamental to the core hypothesis of KIVI. The authors of KIVI explicitly state that their observation of persistent, large-magnitude outliers in fixed channels of the key cache aligns with previous findings in the AWQ paper, providing a critical justification for their decision to quantize the key cache per-channel. [...] KIVI (Key-Value Cache Quantization with Streaming Support) addresses this challenge through a systematic approach that first analyzes the distribution characteristics of KV cache elements, then designs a specialized 2-bit quantization algorithm based on these insights. Unlike previous approaches that apply uniform quantization strategies, KIVI recognizes that keys and values have fundamentally different distribution patterns that require asymmetric treatment.

results.content:
KIVI quantizes key cache per-channel and value cache per-token based on extensive analysis of outlier patterns and quantization error in KV cache.
 KIVI is a plug-and-play 2-bit KV cache quantization algorithm with hardware-friendly implementation that does not require fine-tuning.
 KIVI incorporates a grouped key cache and a residual key cache, maintaining the residual portion in full precision to handle streaming data and ensure accuracy. [...] Quick review

## Motivation & Objective [...] + KIVI, a tuning-free asymmetric 2-bit quantization method, consistently outperforms other 2-bit quantization configurations by quantizing key cache per-channel and value cache per-token. This approach maintains accuracy close to the 16-bit baseline across various LLMs (Llama-2, Mistral, Falcon) and generation tasks (CoQA, TruthfulQA, GSM8K, LongBench), demonstrating its effectiveness in preserving model quality while significantly reducing memory footprint.
